title: Home hero banner + navy/light-blue global theme

requirements.summary: Add the uploaded banner image to the top of the Home page hero section with responsive, non-distorted rendering and English alt text.
acceptanceCriteria: The image file is added to the frontend as a static asset (do not serve it from the backend).
Home page renders the banner at the very top of the hero section (before the H2 heading).
Banner is responsive (scales down on mobile) and maintains aspect ratio (no stretching).
Image includes appropriate English alt text (e.g., "Concept Delta banner").

file_operations.description: Add the uploaded banner image as a static frontend asset (copy from the provided upload) so it can be referenced directly by the Home page without involving the backend.

Update the hero section to render the new banner image above the main H2 heading, centered, responsive, and preserving aspect ratio (e.g., using sizing + object-fit containment to avoid distortion) with English alt text like "Concept Delta banner".

requirements.summary: Switch the global theme tokens to a navy primary with faint/light blue accents so Tailwind/Shadcn styling updates site-wide in light and dark modes without editing shadcn UI component files.
acceptanceCriteria: The primary color is navy blue and secondary/accent colors are faint/light blue (no earth-tone/terracotta palette remains).
Buttons, links, and icon highlights use the updated primary/secondary tokens (e.g., components using text-primary/bg-primary reflect the new navy).
Light mode and dark mode both remain readable with sufficient contrast (foreground text is legible on background and primary surfaces).
No changes are made to files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose/override via tokens and Tailwind usage only).

file_operations.description: Replace the existing earth-tone CSS variables with a navy-blue primary and faint/light-blue secondary/accent palette for both :root and .dark so Tailwind/Shadcn tokens (primary/secondary/accent/muted/border/ring/etc.) inherit the new colors consistently. Use the shadcn-ui token approach (CSS variables consumed by Tailwind colors). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Align any parallel/global CSS theme tokens with the same navy + faint/light blue palette in both light and dark modes to ensure consistent styling regardless of which global stylesheet is imported by the app. Use the shadcn-ui token approach (CSS variables consumed by Tailwind colors). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
